ef8668cd85.q: Why did Daniel McDonnell start Maple Movement with a $30K house deposit?
ef8668cd85.a: After struggling with gut issues from traditional sports gels for years and discovering maple syrup worked for his digestive system, Daniel approached an American maple gel company called Untapped for Australian distribution rights. When they rejected him, he decided to bootstrap the business himself in December, using a $30,000 house deposit to cover corporate structure, legal fees, and trademarks. The money ran out before he even had maple syrup in hand, forcing him to save more and eventually fund the first production run of 20,000 sachets.

3a3045328f.q: What is Maple Movement's product and which sports does it target?
3a3045328f.a: Maple Movement creates all-natural energy gels for sport and endurance with a maximum of three high-quality ingredients, primarily using maple syrup sourced from Vermont and Canada. The gels are designed for three key sport pillars: Hyrox, multi-sport (triathlon), and running. They also serve team sports, with products used by teams in the NRL and AFL, and can be used anywhere fuel is needed during athletic activity.

0b8de19226.q: What production and quality control issues did Maple Movement face with maple syrup packaging in Australia?
0b8de19226.a: Maple Movement experienced five to six major issues over two years, starting with $10-15K in losses from fermented sap in sachets. They then over-corrected by cooking the sap too much, faced crystallized sap creating maple sugar pebbles, suffered leaky sachets, and most recently had a batch fermentation issue in June where sachets inflated like basketballs six to eight weeks after packaging. Daniel wrote off $40,000 in stock and estimated they would have wasted $50-60K total. They refunded all affected customers and went above and beyond by sending replacement boxes express.

fe1e7bf51a.q: How does Maple Movement activate at Hyrox events without official sponsorship fees?
fe1e7bf51a.a: Instead of paying the prohibitive fees for official Hyrox sponsorship (which can cost thousands), Maple Movement hand-distributes 5,000 gels at event doors, creates multiple reels per day with co-founder Ella, and races in the events themselves. They partnered with Australian brand LSKD, which operates community hubs at Hyrox events across hotels; LSKD lets Maple Movement sample products for free at these hubs, creating a cost-effective activation strategy that reaches athletes without expensive expo booth fees.

00665cace3.q: How did Daniel McDonnell's H. pylori bacterial infection lead to creating Maple Movement?
00665cace3.a: After years of gut issues from traditional sports gels, Daniel's condition worsened with severe gastritis, acid reflux, and SIBO-like symptoms. A gastroenterologist in Mackay discovered H. pylori bacteria living in his stomach lining, which required triple therapy (three antibiotics for seven days) to eradicate. During recovery before his pro triathlon debut in Taupo in December, Daniel researched natural fueling and discovered maple syrup worked perfectly—he consumed 80-90 grams of carbs per hour with no gut issues, unlike all other products, sparking the business idea.
